notes: Pre-frozen expectations for the controlled contact-evidence matrix. These are acceptance criteria, not conclusions; raw steps/episodes/manifest and the independent verifier are authoritative.

contact_A_wall.note: Robot flies into the frozen map wall collision prim; IsaacLab filtered contact sensor previously recorded 0.042 N at this wall. Unsupported geometry/envelope warnings do not replace the force evidence.

contact_B_obstacle.note: Kinematic dynamic obstacle crosses a hovering robot. Physics response (robot displaced) alone is not accepted: a real PhysX contact event and/or force must be recorded. If the environment cannot report kinematic-vs-dynamic contacts, classification must be UNKNOWN and the case fails expectation, never geometry-only substitution.

contact_C_clearance.note: Legal close pass at 0.50 m lateral offset: collision geometry gap 0.50 - 0.3382 = 0.1618 m and conservative sphere gap 0.50 - 0.372463 = 0.1275 m, so no contact event and no sphere overlap.

contact_D_geometry.note: Lateral 0.35 m with obstacle size [0.4,0.6,0.6]: obstacle half-width 0.30 + robot collision half-width 0.0382 = 0.3382 m < 0.35 m (no collision-geometry contact), while conservative sphere radii 0.372463 - 0.35 = 0.022463 m > 0.02 m. The difference is produced by real measured collision geometry (body-only collision AABB), not by disabling collisions.

replay_contact_inferred.note: Previous boundary episodes labelled CONTACT_INFERRED. Replay must state CONSISTENT/MISREPORT/MISS/UNDECIDABLE from the new raw contact evidence; other unreplayed episodes keep their previous inference labels and only gain an applicability note.

replay_no_contact.note: Previous NO_CONTACT episode (off-path static obstacle). A replay that now records real contact would be a MISREPORT or a previous label correction; a replay that remains NO_CONTACT is CONSISTENT.

boundary_B_cross_late_r0.rule: CONSISTENT if raw records show a real PhysX contact event/force or an equally valid geometry-only classification with a documented reason; MISREPORT if previous inference was wrong in the opposite direction; UNDECIDABLE if the sensor chain is UNKNOWN during the contact window.

boundary_A_static_offpath_r0.rule: CONSISTENT if raw records show valid sensor, no event, no force, and no sphere overlap while passing the off-path static obstacle.
